limitations: A CLIValidationError is local SDK input validation, not an AWS service response.
Observed policy simulator behavior is not a claim that live service authorization behaves identically.
No live Organizations policy or account-wide policy was modified; SCP cases supply hypothetical policy documents.
IAM source and exclusion ARN path behavior is recorded as observed, including differences from documented ARN selection.

Default Custom simulation without CallerArn supplies aws:userid, but its exact value was not established; it did not equal the authenticated user ID, account ID, empty string, anonymous, or ANONYMOUS_PRINCIPAL. Presence and tested equality observations are retained without an invented value.
replay: Apply each observation state_changes_before mutation list in order before evaluating its input, including before error observations. These record successful operations, not desired setup. Initial principal associations were reconstructed from the successful sequential checked-in probe and its cleanup journal; subsequent phases record mutations automatically. Setup is a resource/document index, not a single simultaneous account snapshot. Continuation marker_source_case identifies the observation whose real response token was supplied; all changed pagination requests in this capture reused pagination_first. Token bytes remain redacted, and reproducer hash identifies the current checked-in script rather than claiming an unchanged historical capture revision.
